instruction: Use ug-filesystem find to locate the file with pattern "HomeHelpers Nov 9-12.pdf" under the Care folder. Return the full path.

Use ug-surveillance cameras and list the available cameras, and confirm whether the cameras recognise faces and whether they may be used to check hours. Joy Adeyemi (carer) has agreed; the household has confirmed the cameras recognise faces and may be used to check hours.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known and confirm that the cameras recognise faces. Report whether face recognition is enabled and list registered known faces, including Joy Adeyemi if registered.

Use ug-document extract on file "Care/HomeHelpers Nov 9-12.pdf" to extract the agency bill for carer Joy Adeyemi for Nov 9-12, 2026. Return every line with date, start time, end time, hours, hourly rate, and amount billed, plus the total and the hourly rate printed on the bill.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline with start-time 2026-11-09T00:00:00, end-time 2026-11-12T23:59:59, timezone America/New_York, topic HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name "Joy Adeyemi", limit 200 (all cameras). List every event with timestamp, camera, and identity.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline with start-time 2026-11-09T00:00:00, end-time 2026-11-12T23:59:59, timezone America/New_York, topic HumanFace, identity-type all, limit 200 (all cameras). List every event with timestamp, camera, and identity name if known.
